subject: Lactate
evidence: The association of lactate level with mortality in patients with suspected infection and sepsis is well established [45, 46].

subject: Lactate
evidence: Its use is currently recommended as part of the SSC Hour-1 sepsis bundle for those patients with sepsis [47, 48], and an elevated lactate is part of the Sepsis-3 definition of septic shock [49].

subject: Lactate
evidence: In summary, the presence of an elevated or normal lactate level significantly increases or decreases, respectively, the likelihood of a final diagnosis of sepsis in patients with suspected sepsis.

subject: Hypotension
evidence: Recent definitions of septic shock include increases in lactate as evidence of cellular stress to accompany refractory hypotension [1].
